hero.label: Made for Juicebox
hero.headline: I want to help Juicebox turn recruiters into AI power users.
hero.subheadline: Juicebox is solving a problem I understand viscerally: finding the right people is hard, and most tools make it harder. The combination of 800M+ profiles, LLM-powered search, and 20%+ monthly growth tells me this is the moment to be selling this product. I want to be the person making those first calls.

whyCompany.title: Ramp, Perplexity, and 3,500+ customers already trust this product
whyCompany.body: When AI labs and high-growth companies like Ramp and Perplexity choose Juicebox, it signals the product is genuinely best-in-class, not just well-marketed. Selling something that top technical teams have already validated makes every outbound conversation easier and more credible. That kind of proof point is a gift for a sales rep who wants to lead with substance.

whyCompany.title: Past $10M ARR, fresh Series B, and a sales team that needs fuel
whyCompany.body: Juicebox just closed an $80M Series B backed by Y Combinator, Coatue, and Bond, which means the company is scaling fast and the SDR hire is a real growth hire, not a backfill. Joining now means I get to help build the outbound motion at a stage where my reps actually matter to the trajectory. That is exactly the kind of ownership I am looking for in a first full-time role.

whyCompany.title: My BDR work at Copygen.ai maps directly onto this motion
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach from scratch, built LinkedIn sequences in HubSpot, and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients in a market that required a lot of education. Juicebox's buyers are recruiters who may not yet see AI sourcing as a must-have, which is the exact same consultative, problem-first selling I already know how to do. My internship at NextAfter, a B2B digital consultancy, added another layer of understanding how to communicate ROI to buyers who need convincing.

quote: I spent over a year cold-calling into skeptical markets and learning to make someone care about a product in 30 seconds. Juicebox is the first company where I have genuinely thought, I would have bought this myself. That is a very different kind of motivation to bring to a sales floor.
